operations.title: Natural theta operators do not isolate the zeta-zero spectrum
operations.statement: On L2(R_+,dx/x), the Mellin dilation generator becomes -i d/dy under y=log x and has continuous spectrum R. Inversion Jf(x)=f(1/x) is a unitary involution with J^2=1 and JDJ=-D, hence only plus/minus-one symmetry spectrum. These natural theta operators encode functional-equation symmetry but do not yield discrete zeta-zero ordinates.
operations.scope: Audit of unmodified archimedean theta operators; no no-go claim for additional source-derived Hilbert-Polya geometry.

operations.title: Continuous-spectrum hostile test
operations.procedure: Conjugate the dilation generator by logarithmic coordinates to momentum on L2(R), use Fourier transformation to compute its spectrum, and compute the inversion involution identities.
operations.expected_result: D has continuous spectrum R and J has spectrum contained in plus/minus one. A discrete compact-resolvent zero spectrum from these unmodified operators would falsify the claim.
